title: Mirchi Vada
description: Jodhpur-style large green chillies stuffed with a spiced potato filling, dipped in besan batter and deep fried.
steps: Mix the mashed potato with the dry mango powder, red chilli powder, fennel seeds and half the salt.
Stuff each slit chilli with the potato mixture, pressing it in firmly.
Whisk the besan with the water, carom seeds, baking soda and the remaining salt into a smooth, thick batter.
Heat the oil in a kadai on medium heat.
Dip each stuffed chilli in the batter to coat well and slide it gently into the oil.
Fry for 4 to 5 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp; drain and serve hot with chutney.
